displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 33 is 3 short and 3 long
meaning: Limit circuit fault. A limit, draft safeguard, flame rollout, or blocked-vent switch is open, or the furnace is in high-heat only after two successive low-heat limit trips. The blower runs for 4 minutes or until the switch remakes, whichever is longer. Open longer than 3 minutes becomes lockout 13.
causes: Dirty filter or restricted duct system
Restricted vent or improper vent sizing
Inadequate combustion air, if the flame rollout switch is open
diySteps: Turn off power and check a dirty air filter. Open return and supply grilles that are blocked
If a rollout switch has opened, leave the furnace off. The chart says the flame rollout switch requires a manual reset
Technician: check the vent, the blower wheel, the switches, and combustion air before anyone resets a rollout switch
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 33 returns after a filter change, or if a rollout switch opened. The 926TB install manual also points lockout 13 at a code 33. That service-label figure is not the list on this page. This list is TG-GFB80-02.
